management_remarks: In Q2 FY25, TCS recorded solid revenue growth led by a decisive turnaround in North America Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) and strong regional market execution. Quarterly deal wins remained robust at USD 8.6 billion with high book-to-bill conversion and industry-best client retention metrics across USD 100M+ accounts. Cash flow from operations reached 101% of Net Profit, supporting our superior Return on Equity of 50.8% and consistent shareholder dividend payouts.
analyst_qa: Addressing analyst questions on GenAI deflationary pressure, clients expect productivity pass-backs in legacy BPO and testing renewals, creating pricing headwinds in commoditized services. Continental Europe manufacturing and automotive verticals remain challenging and uncertain amid macro weakness, with discretionary spend moderating. Margin expansion toward our 26% aspirational band remains subject to foreign exchange volatility and calibrated wage inflation.
